policy.surnames: no surname pools; first names only
policy.allowed_source_names: newly acquired observed male-name sources (no cultural-origin restriction)
policy.source_name_weights: source-published original male name occurrence counts or explicitly labeled published incidence estimates; never invent or aggregate transliteration collisions; weights country-specific and non-comparable
policy.origin_rule: NOT REQUIRED; any male given name reported for the country may be included, irrespective of etymological origin
policy.first_name_format: exactly one male first given name written in Unicode NFC Latin-script letters and Latin-compatible combining marks only (Script=Latin, mark Script_Extensions=Latin); no spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, punctuation, compounds, surnames or mixed-script confusables
policy.year_scope: 2000 onward when birth-year sources permit; older population-based sources may not encode a birth-year cohort
